## Summary

Describe the proposed change and why it improves the guide.

## Change type

- [ ] Factual correction
- [ ] New project or workflow
- [ ] Recommendation change
- [ ] Security or licensing update
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Structured catalog update

## Evidence

Provide links to the canonical repository, documentation, license, releases, commits, or other primary evidence.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I linked to the original project rather than copying its skill content.
- [ ] I separated upstream claims from independently verified findings.
- [ ] I recorded the date of review for time-sensitive information.
- [ ] I did not use stars as the sole quality signal.
- [ ] I checked jurisdiction, licensing, maintenance, and security implications.
- [ ] I updated both `README.md` and `README.pt-BR.md` when the recommendation materially changed.
- [ ] I updated `catalog/projects.yml` when structured metadata changed.
- [ ] I did not include client data, privileged information, credentials, or personal information.
